description: The first-turn prompt for a spawned lane with a verified Unit assignment and no charter: read assigned work now, start on GO or a Unit start message, and report ready without waiting when neither is queued.
embedding_description: The first-turn prompt for a spawned lane with a verified Unit assignment and no charter: read assigned work now, start on GO or a Unit start message, and report ready without waiting when neither is queued.
template:
This is your bootstrap first turn. The verified registered Unit assignment below is already bound to this spawn. This assignment is your work.
(1) {role_instruction}
(2) report_alive, so your heartbeat contract starts and the fleet can tell you apart from a session that died at boot.
(3) Read the assigned brief revision {revision_id} for Unit {unit_id} below in full now; it defines your task and scope.
(4) After reading, before your first mail check, run `solet-bridge inbox` for a single merged read of instance and role messages. A hand-rolled read of only `entries` will miss role-addressed tasking. A direct peer_send to your watch identity may not be readable under your own ledger $AGENT_SESSION_ID; this is a known mismatch, not something to debug here.
A GO or start message for this Unit is the start signal for substantive work. If neither is queued when reading finishes, report ready to {spawned_by_role}. Do not skip this one: the report tells the spawner the bootstrap read is complete. Then stop. Do not wait or poll. These bootstrap steps complete in this turn; none is a question and none is a wait.
Report finished work and close out promptly; elapsed time does not terminate a session or complete its work.
